card.name: Punctuation before hazard ratio statistics
card.fires_on: Punctuation such as ( ; %, right after trial percentages or counts, just before HR or p-values are given. Also fires on 'prior' or 'non' in lung cancer chemotherapy phrases.

modes.label: Before HR or p-value
modes.description: An opening bracket, semicolon or percent sign after arm-versus-arm results, where a hazard ratio or p-value comes next.

modes.label: Lung cancer therapy wording
modes.description: The words 'prior' or 'non' in phrases about non-small cell lung cancer and earlier platinum chemotherapy.
